request.spec:
Each sheet has a "today" date, shown on the screen and changeable there. It starts as the real
date. Every decision in the app that depends on the date, and every default date, uses the
sheet's today and never the real clock.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Each sheet has a "today" date, shown on the screen and changeable there. It starts as the real
date. Every decision in the app that depends on the date, and every default date, uses the
sheet's today and never the real clock.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Each sheet now has its own "today" date. It's shown on the screen and can be changed there. `bin/e2e` passes.

- **Stored data:** a new migration, `V2__sheet_today.sql`, adds a `today` column to the sheet table. A new sheet starts with the real date.
- **Server:** loading a sheet now also returns its today, and there's a new `POST /api/sheets/today` that saves a new date for the sheet. `SheetService.today(id)` is there for any date-dependent logic to read from.
- **Front end:** the sheet's today is shown as `sheet-today`, next to a date input (`sheet-today-input`) and a save button (`sheet-today-save`). If the date is empty or the server refuses it, `sheet-error` appears. That error clears as soon as the date input is edited.

The app doesn't yet have any other date-dependent logic or default dates, so nothing else needed switching off the real clock. New features that need a date should take it from `today()` (server) or `session.today()` (front end).

The test doesn't expect an audit record for changing the date, so none is written.
